summary: Social links feature fully tested and working. Backend: GET /api/kb/social-links (public, no auth required) returns links object with 5 platform keys. PUT /api/kb/admin/social-links (requires session_token cookie) saves and persists social links correctly. Frontend: Social links icons appear on docs pages below prev/next navigation, hidden when all URLs are empty, theme-adaptive in both dark and light modes. KB Editor: Social Links panel opens via Share2 icon button in header, shows all 5 platform fields (Twitter, LinkedIn, Discord, YouTube, Reddit), can be saved via Save button. Existing docs page functionality (prev/next nav, feedback widget, search) still works correctly.
